conclusions.text: All 228 issue IDs map one-to-one to current Atlas features and unique pinned 2017 source shapeIDs; all source Pinyin names match the Atlas strings. This is historical string/source lineage only.

225 features have fewer Atlas vertices than the pinned 2017 source; only three match after rounding source coordinates to four decimal places. Each feature transformation origin remains individually unresolved; these differences do not prove an incorrect boundary.

Current name/code/class/status/parent, completeness, detached parts, islands, coastline, neighboring coverage and legal boundary role remain unresolved for all 228 because current official roster and suitable authoritative polygon originals were not retained.

Chongqing 2025 code-change discovery is a material identity/parent research lead requiring direct retrieval and polygon comparison; this packet does not associate a boundary change with a specific Atlas feature.

For one scoped subject only, the retained Dazhuxian source geometry extent is disjoint from the indexed official Dazhu County reported-location rectangle and intersects the indexed official Dazu District reported-location rectangle. This supports a source name/location inconsistency lead; because official originals and the original-language name/code for the shapeID were not verified, canonical identity, current parent and legal boundaries remain unresolved.
